finding.consequence: An inconsistent saved API/raw pair can pass the stage metadata assertions while policy materialization uses a constructed tree different from the actual commit checked by the original gate. This is a static input-validation gap, not evidence that an actual saved GitHub API record was falsified.
finding.issue: The raw-commit OID is checked, but its actual tree/parent headers are not independently compared to the reconstructed stage tree/direct predecessor. Subsequent diff verification compares path/status sets, not blob values, so it is not a replacement for this binding.
finding.scope: Optional supplied raw-commit branch; unsigned reconstructed branch already derives its raw tree/parents from the checked API.
finding.v2_resolution: After put(commit), unconditionally cat-file the actual commit object and require exactly one tree header equal to the reconstructed tree plus exactly one parent equal to previous_commit; the same check covers both raw and unsigned branches.
